parsed.explanation: Lemma 2 is the load-bearing finiteness step: it is what forces every prime of every minimal support into a bounded-weight (hence bounded, small-prime) terminal support, i.e. the large-prime-erasure content of L6.2. The write-up's proof reads in full: 'This follows by a descent on the weight w (standard; details omitted).' No argument is given anywhere else; the 'Approaches tried' section only sketches the same descent informally ('Removing one prime from a minimal support produces a rejected support; its smaller coprime witness yields a strict weight descent'), which is a sketch, not an all-cases proof, and in any case is not part of the proof body. Lemma 1 and the periodicity assembly both depend on Lemma 2 for the bound |D| <= a_1.
